title: Stop selling your time. Sell one finished thing.
topic: Turning one skill into a fixed-price AI-assisted service
target_audience: Employees with a skill who want a side income
audience_problem: They have a skill but freelancing feels vague and hard to price

beats.voiceover: Stop selling your time. Sell one finished thing.
beats.visual: Close-up, confident; on 'finished thing' cut to a neat package icon.

beats.voiceover: 'I can help with marketing' is vague. Vague offers are hard to price and hard to say yes to.
beats.visual: Fuzzy, blurred text 'I can help with marketing' that sharpens into a clear offer.

beats.voiceover: Pick one task you're already good at, like writing product descriptions.
beats.visual: Text card '1', screen of an online shop product page.

beats.voiceover: Package it: a fixed amount, a fixed price, a fixed delivery time.
Use AI for the first draft, then your skill to edit, check and personalise. That's what people pay for.
beats.on_screen_text: 3. AI drafts. You make it good.
beats.visual: Screen recording: AI draft appears, then manual edits highlighted.

beats.voiceover: Twenty product descriptions for your shop, delivered in three days, one fixed price. Easy to say yes to.
Comment your skill and I'll suggest a package.

instagram.caption:
Vague offers are hard to buy. Packaged offers are easy to say yes to.

1. Pick one task you're already good at
2. Fix the amount, the price and the delivery time
3. Let AI draft - your skill makes it good (and be upfront with clients about how you work)

Comment your skill and I'll suggest a package.
